Wednesday Morning Velo

Boulder, CO · North Boulder · Road

Wednesday Morning Velo is a road group ride in Boulder, CO. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 am from Gateway Fun Park parking lot. About 20–25 (Rocky Ride) and longer miles, six groups; slowest 13–15 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @wednesdayvelo the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Morning Velo group ride

A big Boulder business-community ride with six pace groups and free coffee and pastries at Amante afterward. A slower 'Rocky Ride' leaves Amante at 8:30 am. Summer only.
